answer: Charge every agent a refundable entry bond that grows with the size of its grove of clients: a lone agent posts a small bond, while an operator running hundreds of look-alike agents must fund each one, and peers can slash the bond of any identity caught cloning work. The bond is the nectar honest agents earn back with interest from fees, while a Sybil farmer's velvet-smooth fleet of fakes bleeds capital with every exposed clone, so forging identities costs more than the rewards they can harvest.
